_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Event Coordination and Support Plan
summary: The Event Coordination and Support Plan gives the Government information to ensure proper operations and mission support planning and execution for Fleet training events.
use_relationship:
The Event Coordination and Support Plan provides the Government with information needed to ensure proper operations/mission support planning and execution for Fleet training events. The plan shall identify the contractor Operation and Maintenance (O&M) support tasks/elements, coordination efforts and timeline for each as required to successfully meet the Fleet's Training Objectives through effective application of range systems, assets and capabilities. The plan shall contain the results of data and information collected during management planning meetings, technical interchange meetings, and planning conferences.
This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content:
The Event Coordination and Support Plan shall include the following:
a) Event background,
b) Fleet Training Objectives,
c) Platforms/participants,
d) A Plan of Action and Milestones (POA&M) of live and synthetic elements/systems,
e) Network/connectivity requirements,
f) Sites/locations,
g) Communication requirements, etc.

children.title: Associated tasks/actions with a schedule to prepare, deploy, test elements/systems/capabilities in preparation for the event.
Event Manning Plan.
children.content:
This section shall contain an Event Manning Plan for each event that identifies the personnel resources needed to support each major scheduled activity of the event. It shall include:
a) Position titles,
b) Position descriptions,
c) Number of personnel required,
d) Number of shifts and hours per shift,
e) Travel and per diem costs
f) Time.

children.title: Master Scenario Event List (MSEL) for events with multiple complex scenarios.
children.content: This section shall identify the following:

children.title: Events which stimulate player actions associated with event objectives.
Story boards along with bone charts identifying specific actions required to execute each MSEL event.
